note: Small, plain campground on Green Hill Rd off Route 58 in Lowell (not the Hazen's Notch ski and hiking center), reached by a gravel/dirt road. Grassy and wooded sites beside a stocked pond: the open lawn at the pond's south end looks over the water, while the trailers back in the woods to the northwest do not. Many sites are seasonal (a 2026 camper report found most occupants seasonal), and on a summer 2026 weekend the whole campground was rented for a private party, so confirm by phone. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read live through the headless browser (plain HTTP is a Mod_Security 406): $50 daily / $300 weekly / $900 monthly / $2,100 seasonal (raised from $40 since the 2025-07-11 Wayback capture), 50 sites (30 RV, 20 tent or trailer), hot showers, dump station, phone-only booking; hookups 'with hookups', 'H20 and some electrified'. Fees, booking, sites, facilities confirmed; derived 50-amp, sewer and May-Oct season cleared (operator silent). Price exactly at the $50 line, no Good Sam/gateway; Google 4.5/17; a 2026 review says most occupants are seasonal and another found the park rented out for a private biker party. Lakeview kept on the operator's pond-lawn photo; lakefront lead for the open lawn sites, unnumbered.
flags: PRICE GATE: $50 a night (operator, posted after July 2025; $40 in the 2025-07-11 capture) - exactly at the line, not over it. Single flat rate, no shoulder pricing; tax not stated. Not a Good Sam Park (not in the GS directory cache), no member discount posted, gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest Montreal 113 km). Not stayed at by the family (campground_references: none). Google 4.5 over 17 reviews; RV Life 4.5 over 2 (last review 2013), $$.

BORDERLINE / POLICY (AWH 2026-10-31 rule: borderline price + questionable policies may drop): Google review '4 months ago' (~July 2026, 3 stars): 'Called earlier in the week, asked the owner about staying there this weekend. He said no problem, plenty of room. 50 bucks for the weekend. Drove up with my camper, wife and 2 kids and found out it was rented out for a private biker party. Live music till midnight. 50 bucks each if we wanted to join.' Google review '4 years ago' (1 star): 'Called in April for a late June reservation. They said it was too soon, call back later ... left two voice mails, no return calls. When we finally got through they were full.' Phone-only booking, no engine. I read it as borderline: price at the line, few reviews, whole-park private-event rental. Reviewer decides.

LONG-STAY (five tests): (1) $50 - passes at the line; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site + phone - passes; (3) no minimum posted - passes; (4) nightly share: Google review '2 months ago' (~Sep 2026, 5 stars): '50 bucks cash will get you a peaceful night ... Most of the people there seem to be seasonal campers'; the operator also sells weekly/monthly and a $2,100 season (= 42 nights at the daily rate); the undated leaf-off Esri frame shows ~12 trailers left on site (8 in the NW loop with decks/sheds, ~4 along the access road) against 30 RV + 20 tent-or-trailer sites, i.e. roughly a quarter to half of the park, while 2026 reviewers did get single nights ('plenty of room') - nightly share not measurable exactly (no engine, no map), estimated above 10%, likely 10-50% band for RV sites; (5) no homes/lots for sale or resident wording seen. No discouraging wording on the operator page. Not clearly 'mostly seasonal', but seasonal-leaning: the proposed note carries a seasonal caveat.

WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT (sweep value, not --AWH). The water is a ~9.3 ha (~23 acre) pond on imagery - over the 5-acre pond line. The operator's own 'Private Pond...' slide shows a tent pitched on an open mown lawn with the pond across open grass; that lawn (picnic tables around 44.8266,-72.4836) lies 25-40 m from the pond's south shore over grass with a narrow reed/brush fringe. The RV units visible on imagery are 150-220 m west of the shore through woods (NW loop ~44.8285,-72.4870) - no view from there.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not an upgrade): the lawn sites at the pond's south end (~44.8266,-72.4836) are within ~25-40 m of the water over open ground, but there is no site map or site numbering anywhere, the operator photo shows a tent there, and whether they are among the '20 tent or trailer sites' a 23-ft motorhome may use, or are sold by the night, is unknown - so no lakefront call.

HOOKUPS: electric 50 and sewer true cleared (derived from old note prose; operator says only 'with hookups' / 'H20 and some electrified'; RV Life's own JSON lists cg_50amp and cg_sewer both as 'yes' and false). Water true confirmed. Electric presence kept in hookups.note (no amperage to write).
